provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Hacker at Every Level

examples.psychological_goal: 用章节卡+最小年龄定格纯真的起点
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级章节卡+最小年龄（12岁的好奇孩子）
examples.example_text: Level one, the curious kid. You are 12 years old.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第X级+绰号」开场卡，起点越小，后面的下坠越重
examples.negative_instruction: 绰号必须是中性偏褒（curious kid），反讽留给后文

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个行为画像代替性格形容词
examples.expression_mechanism: 异类行为画像（读打印机说明书）
examples.example_text: You were the kid who reads the manual that came with the printer.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你是那种会X的孩子」的句式给天赋找证据
examples.negative_instruction: 行为必须小到可笑又可信，不可写「他从小热爱技术」

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连隐喻重写世界观
examples.expression_mechanism: 门-锁-失效三连（登录框=门）
examples.example_text: Every login box is a door. Every door has a lock. Every lock can fail.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用Every X is a Y的三连把日常界面改写成攻击面
examples.negative_instruction: 三连必须同构递进（门→锁→失效），不可换意象

examples.psychological_goal: 用绰号定义+刺痛判词完成羞辱教育
examples.expression_mechanism: 污名定义+「刺痛因为是真的」
examples.example_text: Script kiddie. It is an insult. It means you use weapons you do not understand. It stings because it is true.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「名词+它是侮辱+定义+它刺痛因为是真的」四拍写一次羞辱
examples.negative_instruction: 刺痛必须归因于真实，不可写成委屈

examples.psychological_goal: 用双向隐喻种下偏执
examples.expression_mechanism: 门双向摆动（猎人也是被看的人）
examples.example_text: You realize there are people watching. You realize the door swings both ways.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把已建立的隐喻（门）反向使用，让安全感翻面
examples.negative_instruction: 反转必须复用前文意象，不可新造比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用钥匙隐喻给「发现」定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 钥匙隐喻（锁匠不知道的钥匙）
examples.example_text: You are holding a key the people who built the lock do not know exists.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你握着一把X都不知道的钥匙」写漏洞的独占感
examples.negative_instruction: 锁与钥匙必须与全片门/锁母题一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句反问开启堕落长线
examples.expression_mechanism: 脑后反问+按下（如果没这么诚实呢）
examples.example_text: What if you had not been so honest? You push the voice away.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句反问种下诱惑，用「按下」标记它还会回来
examples.negative_instruction: 反问必须简短，不可当时就回答

examples.psychological_goal: 用「站在线上」写合法与非法的灰度
examples.expression_mechanism: 线之判词（线比承认的细/每天站在线上）
examples.example_text: The line between the two is thinner than anyone admits. You stand on that line every single day.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「线比X承认的细」+「每天站在线上」写职业的灰色日常
examples.negative_instruction: two 的两端必须已建立（像罪犯思考/保持合法）

examples.psychological_goal: 用强弱对置给出社会工程定律
examples.expression_mechanism: 最强防火墙 vs 友善声音
examples.example_text: You learn that the strongest firewall in the world is useless against a friendly voice.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「最强的X对Y毫无用处」揭示人的因素
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须微小（friendly voice），与X形成量级反差

examples.psychological_goal: 拆穿「决定越界」的叙事幻觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 渐进越界（不是某一刻，是一小步一小步）
examples.example_text: You did not decide to cross the line in one moment. You crossed it slowly, one small job at a time.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不是某一刻，是一点一点」拆穿堕落需要仪式的幻觉
examples.negative_instruction: 小步必须可数（one small job），不可写「慢慢变坏」

examples.psychological_goal: 用工作定义句给共谋洗白
examples.expression_mechanism: 职责化共谋（不问就是这份工作）
examples.example_text: You stopped asking what the data will be used for. Not asking is the job.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「停止问X，不问就是这份工作」写道德责任的移交
examples.negative_instruction: 句子必须是中性的工作口吻，不可露出辩解

examples.psychological_goal: 用变量对照写技能的中立性
examples.expression_mechanism: 技能同一，结局变量（只有结局变了）
examples.example_text: The skills are identical. Only the ending changed.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「A一模一样，只有B变了」写合法与非法的同一套手艺
examples.negative_instruction: 必须紧接着给B的两个实例（写报告/留字条）

examples.psychological_goal: 用「容易」反向写腐蚀
examples.expression_mechanism: 容易递增的恐惧（每次更容易才可怕）
examples.example_text: Each time it gets a little easier, and that is the part that scares you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把「变容易」写成最坏的征兆，而非成长
examples.negative_instruction: scares 的对象必须是「容易」本身，不可写成怕被抓

examples.psychological_goal: 让受害方亲口向加害方提问
examples.expression_mechanism: 亲人的无心之问+你的否认
examples.example_text: She is shaken. She asks if you have heard of such things. You say no.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让受害者（妹妹）向加害者（你）描述你的作品，再让你说「没有」
examples.negative_instruction: 否认必须是全句最短的一句，不可给解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用孩子的相信给谎言称重
examples.expression_mechanism: 孩子的全信+体内的断裂
examples.example_text: You tell him you keep computers safe. He smiles and believes you completely. You smile back and feel something break inside you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他完全相信」与「你感到断裂」的对置写谎言的成本
examples.negative_instruction: 谎言本身必须接近事实（keep computers safe），才更疼

examples.psychological_goal: 用二选一写国家的收编逻辑
examples.expression_mechanism: 二选一收编（逮捕或使用）
examples.example_text: They had two options, arrest you or use you. They chose to use you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「两个选项，他们选了X」写权力的冷静算计
examples.negative_instruction: 选项必须并列冷酷（arrest/use），不可带感激

examples.psychological_goal: 用换名不换活拆穿合法性
examples.expression_mechanism: 换旗不换活（为旗帜而非赎金）
examples.example_text: You steal secrets for a flag instead of for a ransom.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「为了A而非B」把合法性还原成雇主变更
examples.negative_instruction: A/B必须是同一动作的两个买家（flag/ransom）

examples.psychological_goal: 用愿望实现式反讽完成主题反转
examples.expression_mechanism: 愿望实现反讽（得到了一切，成为认不出的东西）
examples.example_text: You got everything that kid wanted. You got it by becoming something he would not recognize.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你得到了X想要的，但以变成Y的方式」完成欲望的反讽结账
examples.negative_instruction: kid 必须是开场建立的那个自己，不可泛化

examples.psychological_goal: 用一次错过给优先级结账
examples.expression_mechanism: 错过的最后一面+「你错了」短判
examples.example_text: Your mom passed while you were on a job you cannot describe. You missed the last weeks.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「她在X时去世，你错过了Y」给「工作不能等」自我审判
examples.negative_instruction: 原因（cannot describe）必须点到为止，不可解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用同一句问题完成循环
examples.expression_mechanism: 循环回收（同一个搜索问题+同一个无底的洞）
examples.example_text: He types a question into a search bar. How do websites work? The answer pulls him down a hole that has no bottom.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场的好奇原封不动复制给新人物，让门再开一次
examples.negative_instruction: 问题必须与开场逐字一致（How do websites work），不可改写
